decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanBlock PlanDWG 01DWG 02DWG 03DWG 04DWG 05Design and Access StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 18 Minchenden Crescent N14 7EL.Reason: To ensure that the development does not detract from the amenity of the adjoining properties, and to enable the Local Planning Authority to retain control over the use of the building.

Prior to above ground works the development hereby approved (including demolition and all preparatory work), details of foundation specification and installation methodology shall be submitted in writing to the Local Planning Authority. The details shall have regard for the neighbouring trees and their RPA (root protection area as defined by BS5837:2012), and shall demonstrate how the specification is suitable for the purpose, including how the foundations will be installed without harm to the underlying tree roots.There shall be no storage of equipment or materials, and no mixing of cement within the RPA of the trees. Any use of concrete will involve an impermeable membrane to prevent leaching into the root area.Reason: To ensure the retention of and avoidance of damage to retained trees on and off site in the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with Development Management Document Policy DMD80.
